default.description: Final design: analyst + implementer + tester on Sonnet 5.5, reviewer on Opus 5.5 in its own job with an isolated context.

E1-same-model.description: Experiment E1a: the reviewer uses the same model as the implementer (Sonnet 5.5). Everything else as default.

E1-sees-rationale.description: Experiment E1b: the reviewer also gets the PR description written by the author (implementer rationale). Everything else as default.

E2-self-test.description: Experiment E2: no separate tester. The implementer writes the tests for its own code (same model, gets its own implementation notes).

smoke-haiku.description: Cheap smoke test of the plumbing: every role on Haiku 5.5. Not used for results.
